name: Bobby Santiago
source:
Bobby Santiago is formerly the biggest Himbo in all of Royal Woods. Blessed with good looks like his little sister [url=https://vndb.org/c151342]Ronnie[/url], Bobby, became an honest man after asking out my big sister [url=https://vndb.org/c151346]Lori[/url]. The two have been together and inseparable since. Really, it's almost annoying with how much they love one another and how they can't go more than 10 minutes without talking to each other. I guess I can't blame Lori too much, I kind of like his sister Ronnie almost in the same way...and I guess I can't blame him, even I can tell Lori is beautiful and a great girlfriend.

Bobby isn't the sharpest knife in the drawer, in fact I think he could give [url=https://vndb.org/c151354]Leni[/url] a run for her money on who's more air-headed! But just like my big sis Leni, Bobby has a heart of gold and is a really good guy.

He's a lot of fun to hang out with too, and Lori once had to make him promise not to steal [url=https://vndb.org/c151341]me[/url] away for the little brother he always wanted!

[In game description]
